content.text:
I fixed this in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`. `v-for` no longer turns the items of a `shallowReactive` array into reactive objects, so `item.aaa` stays a ref and the issue's example should print "object object".

**Cause:** when `v-for` looped over any reactive array, `renderList` wrapped every item with `toReactive`. That's correct for normal reactive arrays, but a `shallowReactive` array is meant to hand back its items untouched. Wrapping them made the refs inside unwrap automatically, which is why the template showed "string".

**Fix:** `renderList` now checks `isShallow(source)` and only wraps items when the array is *not* shallow. Shallow arrays are still read through `shallowReadArray`, so the loop still re-renders when the array changes.

The existing `renderList` tests pass (7/7). I didn't add a test for the shallow case or run the issue's example myself.
